title: Cheapest of the cheap, bad paint, not worth it
text:
Cheapest of the cheap, bad paint, not worth it. We are huge Doctor Who fans at our place.
We buy a lot of DW items to display in the room we watch movies in.

I have Daleks from at least three different manufacturers, and this one is the WORST.
Normally, Kurt Adler products have been great. Not this one.
It is cheaply made, even for a cheap item.
The paint job is sloppy at best. The arms are bent as well.

It is so ugly, I am going to just repaint it myself.
Maybe I got a bad one, but I'm guessing that it is this dalek.
Good luck to you if you buy one.
